entries.message: Feature - Simplify rating and watchlist sync to one toggle and fix Plex watchlist delivery
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Personal Rating Sync and Personal Watchlist Sync each collapse to a single on/off control that syncs two-way with every connected Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, and Trakt account, with Plembfin as the conflict authority and a safe first-run union an empty provider snapshot cannot erase

Watchlist sync now explains anything a service refuses instead of only saying attention is needed: a refused sign-in names the service and links to its connection settings, a rejected change shows the provider's own error and when the next attempt is due, and a title missing from an Emby or Jellyfin library is reported as expected rather than a fault, with a Retry queued changes button

Fixed Plex watchlist sync end to end: reading the watchlist, resolving a title, adding, and removing all used endpoints Plex does not serve, so nothing reached Plex and additions made there were never imported into Plembfin

Fixed the app freezing for up to a minute at a time, which also dropped the background scheduler and stalled every page: building the dashboard Up Next rail blocked the whole server and now completes in under a second

Metadata is warmed in the background as media is discovered through library webhooks and provider Up Next feeds, so dashboards and detail pages stay cache-first instead of downloading during a request
Up Next cards gained Remove from up next, which dismisses the item through each provider's own native endpoint and clears local progress
Episode cards no longer route through episode-level provider ids, so a deep link from a card opens the correct show instead of an unrelated one
Discover, Watchlist, Ratings, Custom Lists, and History now use the compact poster-first card geometry at mobile widths
